advisories.title: Jinja2 regular expression denial of service
advisories.description: Jinja2 before 2.11.3 is vulnerable to ReDoS via the urlize filter.

advisories.title: Flask denial of service via crafted JSON
advisories.description: Flask before 0.12.3 allows denial of service through specially crafted JSON input.

advisories.title: Django SQL injection via QuerySet.order_by()
advisories.description: Django allows SQL injection through unsanitised order_by input.

advisories.title: PyYAML arbitrary code execution via full_load
advisories.description: PyYAML before 5.4 allows code execution when processing untrusted YAML.

advisories.title: Requests leaks the Proxy-Authorization header
advisories.description: Requests before 2.31.0 forwards the Proxy-Authorization header across redirects.

advisories.title: urllib3 denial of service via crafted URL
advisories.description: urllib3 before 1.26.5 is vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking on crafted URLs.
